comparison.objective: Seat four long studs on edge in layout-jig slots against an end fence.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part handling, orientation, slot alignment, and insertion against constraints.
comparison.success_condition: Each stud must satisfy edge orientation, squareness, bottom height, slot alignment, fence gap, and stability tolerances.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment and seating do not establish overlap with adjustable damping, setscrew torque, or stopping-response validation.
